research_question: Does any one of the five language dictionaries used by Nepal and Perono (2024) show excess raw exact consonant-cluster overlap with the paper-exact Linear A master list beyond two pre-frozen matched chance models, before manual semantic filtering?

fixed_scope.primary_unit: raw exact consonant-cluster match before manual plausibility, meaning, or tablet-context filtering

must_establish: which column is consumed as the Linear A comparison string
whether duplicate Linear A rows are retained
whether duplicate source rows are retained
the admitted Linear A comparison strings correspond to the 2024 study input
they are not silently regenerated from an alternate public-program configuration

must_explicitly_freeze: input field consumed for Linear A
vowel deletion set and deletion order
UPSTREAM_TEXT_NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.minimum_canary_requirement: At least one mechanically verified input/output canary for every normalization operation that is not identity-preserving; if an operation is explicitly identity-preserving, that state must be recorded.
acceptable_evidence: paper-exact executable plus mechanically verified canary inputs/outputs
author-supplied exact preprocessing specification tied to the study files
unacceptable_evidence: README prose alone for unspecified behaviors
reverse engineering published selected match tables
best-fit behavior chosen to maximize or minimize any language score

admitted_normalized_record_contract.rule: JANUS corrective statistics consume admitted normalized clusters; they do not perform undocumented upstream text normalization.
admitted_normalized_record_contract.cluster_length_unit: Unicode code-point length of the admitted normalized cluster

upstream_raw_match_reproduction_layer.operation: exact string equality between admitted normalized Linear A cluster and admitted normalized dictionary cluster

frozen_metrics.definition: Number of distinct eligible admitted normalized Linear A clusters having at least one exact match in a language dictionary.
Number of admitted Linear A row x dictionary row exact cluster matches, retaining source-row multiplicity.
Number of distinct admitted normalized dictionary clusters having at least one eligible Linear A exact match.

preserves: global Unicode code-point multiset across admitted normalized clusters
algorithm: For one language, concatenate the Unicode code points of all admitted normalized non-empty dictionary clusters in source-row order.
Apply the deterministic iteration-specific random permutation to that exact code-point multiset.
Redistribute the permuted code points according to the original ordered admitted cluster-length sequence.
Keep admitted normalized Linear A clusters fixed.
Recompute all frozen metrics without meanings or published-match protection.

preserves: each language row count within every exact length stratum
algorithm: Pool all admitted normalized dictionary rows from the five fixed languages.
Within each exact code-point-length stratum, deterministically permute language labels while preserving observed language row counts in that stratum.
Keep cluster strings, row multiplicity, and admitted normalized Linear A clusters fixed.
Recompute all frozen metrics for all five languages within the same permutation.

permutation_protocol.exact_enumeration_rule: If the number of distinct admissible permutations for a null family is less than 10000, enumerate all distinct admissible permutations instead of resampling duplicates.
permutation_protocol.deterministic_seed_rule: Interpret SHA256(artifact_uuid || '|' || null_family_id || '|' || zero_based_iteration) as an unsigned big-endian integer.
permutation_protocol.empirical_one_sided_p: (1 + count(null_stat >= observed_stat)) / (B + 1) for sampled permutations; exact tail proportion for complete exact enumeration.

familywise_control.method: within-null-family permutation max-statistic across all five languages

decision_rule.BLOCKED: One or more required exact-input/normalization receipts are absent or invalid.
decision_rule.UPSTREAM_RAW_MATCH_REPRODUCTION_MISMATCH: Paper-exact admitted inputs are present but the mechanically reconstructed raw exact-match layer disagrees with any paper-exact raw-output canaries or counts that were frozen before corrective statistics.
decision_rule.EXECUTED_NO_EXCESS: No language has positive excess and FWER-adjusted p <= 0.05 under both N1 and N2 for the primary metric.
decision_rule.EXECUTED_DISCORDANT_NULLS: At least one language clears the frozen primary threshold under only one of N1/N2, with no language clearing both.
decision_rule.EXECUTED_TECHNICAL_OVERLAP_EXCESS_SIGNAL: At least one language has positive observed-minus-null-mean and FWER-adjusted p <= 0.05 under both N1 and N2 for UNIQUE_LINEAR_A_CLUSTER_HIT_COUNT.
